_why: XbSymbolDatabase does not cover XMV, the video library, so these
addresses had no names and could not be replaced by name. Without them
the title decodes its intro movies (Movie/Intro/int_thq.xmv first) with
its own lifted decoder and every frame after the legal screen is black:
the shadow renderer saw 2 texture uploads and no re-uploads in 660 swaps.
scripts/section_calls.py finds seven calls crossing into the XMV section
(0x0020A480..0x00232314). Create and Destroy sit at the same offsets into
the section as Breakdown's, Future Perfect's and Black's (+0x10D, +0x651);
the rest are named from how the player code at 0x000211F0..0x000217CC
calls them, against the protocol in src/hle/hle_xmv.c.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreate
symbols._note: 0x0020A58D, from 0x00021612 in the player at 0x000215F0, three arguments; the player calls its stream-info reader (0x000211F0) straight after.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackDestroy
symbols._note: 0x0020AAD1, from 0x0002141E with the handle; the caller zeroes its handle field at +0x10C after.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackGetStreamInfo
symbols._note: 0x0020ABB3, from 0x00021214: (handle, the player's +0x110); the caller then reads the audio stream count at +0x11C.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackGetAudioStreamInfo
symbols._note: 0x0020ABCF, from 0x0002123D in a loop over the audio stream count and from 0x000216D0/0x000216FD: (handle, index, &info); the caller tests the format tag for 0x69 (Xbox ADPCM).

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreateAudioStream
symbols._note: 0x0020AC67, from 0x00021721, 0x00021792 and 0x000217B8: (handle, index, 0, info or NULL, &stream).

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackStart
symbols._note: 0x0020ADE4, from 0x000217A6 with the handle, before the first Update.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackUpdate
symbols._note: 0x0020ADF1, from 0x0002136A in 0x000212F0: (handle, a surface from the player's table at +0x134, &status, user); the caller compares the status with 1.
